title: Kiss cam: one of you hides, one points, then a hand heart
summary: Put you and your partner on a stadium kiss-cam screen. One ducks, one points, and you finish with a hand heart. Sweet, silly and no kiss needed.
why: Remake the Trend's AI video list, updated November 18, 2026, added a "Kiss Cam" trend that day: the big stadium screen shows two people inside a heart frame, one hides while the other points at them, then they make a hand heart together. Our other couple packs are a photobooth strip and a gold-lit silhouette; this one puts you on the big screen.
steps: Pick one clear photo of the two of you, faces visible, or two separate photos side by side. Only use someone who has agreed to be in it.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with that photo. Make a few versions and keep the one where the hide and the point look most natural.
Add a cheerful crowd sound or an upbeat song from your app's library.
Post with a caption like "caught on the kiss cam" and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the hide and point
prompts.text: Animate this photo as a 10-second vertical clip. The two people in my photo sit side by side in the stands of a busy indoor arena at night. A huge screen above the crowd shows them live, framed by a glowing pink heart border with small hearts floating around it. They notice they're on the screen. One of them gasps and hides their face behind a jacket. The other laughs and points at them. Then they both turn to the camera and make a heart shape together with their hands. The crowd around them cheers. Keep both faces clearly recognizable. Bright arena lights, warm and playful mood. No text, no logos, no team names.

prompts.label: Variation: you and your pet
prompts.text: Animate this photo of me and my pet as a 10-second vertical clip. We sit together in the stands of a packed arena. The giant screen above shows us inside a glowing heart frame. My pet sees itself on the screen, tilts its head, then hides behind my arm. I laugh and point at it. Then my pet pops back out and gives the camera a happy look while I make a heart with my hands. The crowd cheers. Keep my face and my pet's markings the same as the photo. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: best friends
prompts.text: Animate this photo of two friends as a 10-second vertical clip. They sit in the stands at a bright indoor arena. The big screen shows them inside a heart frame. Both look shocked, then one points at the other and shakes their head, laughing. The other shrugs, then they both make a big heart over their heads with their arms. The crowd laughs and cheers. Keep both faces recognizable. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: the shop cam
prompts.text: Animate this photo of my shop counter as a 10-second vertical clip. A small TV screen behind the counter shows a live shot of a happy customer and their friend, framed by a glowing pink heart. They spot themselves, one hides behind a shopping bag and the other points and laughs. Then they both make a hand heart at the camera. Keep the shop's look the same as the photo. Warm, friendly lighting. No text, no logos.

tips: Describe the order clearly: "first hides, then points, then a hand heart". Tools follow a simple sequence better.
Keep team names, logos and real stadiums out of the prompt.
For the business version, only use photos of real customers who said yes. A made-up customer works too.
Say it's made with AI in your caption.
